name: learndash
title: LearnDash
description: Course enrolment, completed lessons and topics, quiz attempts and scores, and course completion from LearnDash, the WordPress LMS. Pair it with the engagement kit for lesson video.

platforms.name: LearnDash
platforms.notes: Needs the companion WordPress plugin, which prints the learner, the page and the learning events recorded since the last page.

journey.label: Finishes the last lesson and the course

howItWorks.summary: Reads the learning events the companion WordPress plugin prints on each page, because LearnDash completes lessons and quizzes with form posts the browser never sees. The one in-page signal, starting a quiz, it reads from the click.

steps.title: Reads what just happened, from the server
steps.detail: At init it reads `window.ddRumLearnDash`: the learner's WordPress user ID, the course and step the page shows, and the events recorded since the last page (enrolment, completed lessons and topics, graded quizzes, course completion). The user ID goes to `setUser`; nothing else about the learner is read.

steps.title: Reports each event once
steps.detail: Every printed event carries an `id`. The plugin reports an ID once and records it in `dd_rum_learning_seen` in localStorage for 24 hours, so a reloaded or cached page that prints the same events again sends nothing twice. An event with no ID is dropped, since it could not be reported only once.

steps.title: Hears the quiz start
steps.detail: On a quiz page it adds one capture-phase `click` listener on `document`, and sends `learning.quiz_start` when the click lands on the start button: WP Pro Quiz's `[name="startQuiz"]` by default, or `quizStartSelector`.

steps.title: Scores, never answers
steps.detail: A graded quiz sends its score, the points available, whether it passed and which attempt it was. The answers are never sent, even when the payload holds them. Lesson video is not LearnDash's to report: add the engagement kit, which reads it from the page.

steps.title: Consent
steps.detail: It has no consent source of its own, so it never touches RUM's tracking consent. On its own it sends freely and leaves consent to the host page; next to a consent plugin it sends nothing, not even the learner ID, until that plugin reports a grant.

options.name: events
options.description: Allow-list of learning actions. Every action in the family by default.

options.name: identifyUsers
options.description: Call setUser with the WordPress user ID. Never the email or name.

options.name: consent
options.description: auto follows any consent plugin on the page and sends freely when there is none; ignore skips the gate; or supply a resolver callback.

options.name: quizStartSelector
options.description: The element that starts a quiz attempt. WP Pro Quiz's start button by default.

options.name: dataGlobal
options.description: Global holding the server-printed learner, page and learning events.

options.name: beforeTrack
options.description: Edit or drop an event before it is sent.

options.name: debug
options.description: Log every mapped event to the console.
